items.title: MNCs cashing in on China's further opening-up
items.description: Editor's note: As the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting concluded on Thursday in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, the bilateral and multilateral talks highlighted the importance of open markets, technological innovation and closer business and trade cooperation amid a changing global economic landscape. China's continued opening-up, its efforts to integrate artificial intelligence into the real economy, and its strengths in advanced manufacturing and green technologies are creating new opportunities for companies across the Asia-Pacific region. In this special Q&A, foreign business executives share their perspectives on how these developments can boost productivity, accelerate the ongoing green transition and deepen regional commercial ties. The broader opportunity lies not only in individual markets, but in building more resilient, innovative and sustainable growth across the region.
